notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 8th 2023
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the game crashed on 20 July after buying a lottery ticket.

notes.title: Remastered Version is Live!
notes.notes:
At last, the remastered version of True Love '95 is now out of beta!

This remaster ports the game to Renpy so that it runs smoothly on modern systems. You can choose upon launch whether to play the remastered or original version.

We hope you enjoy diving back into this retro classic visual novel with upgraded quality of life features such as the ability to resize the window with sacrificing the fidelity of the gorgeous pixel art.

IMPORTANT: Please note that save files are not compatible between versions.
